component.name: LineupTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "poll" end sub
' Fetch the remote's peek line-up (LXC 118's /peek/index.json) every 15 s ' and publish it only when it changes. A Task runs on its own thread: ' SceneGraph does no network I/O on the render thread. A server that is ' down costs one 5 s timeout per round and leaves the last line-up up. sub poll() port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") while true http = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") http.SetMessagePort(port) http.SetUrl(m.top.url) if http.AsyncGetToString() msg = wait(5000, port) if type(msg) = "roUrlEvent" if msg.GetResponseCode() = 200 body = msg.GetString() if body <> "" and body <> m.top.content then m.top.content = body end if else http.AsyncCancel() end if end if sleep(15000) end while end sub
